cards.title: Crowded nest: Adult kids and parents living together
cards.body: With record numbers of adult children living at home, experts recommend setting ground rules early and respecting each other's privacy. Avoid reverting to old parent-child dynamics to make the arrangement work for everyone.

cards.title: Loss of human connection is biggest threat to kids
cards.body: A pediatrician warns that screens are less harmful than the loss of genuine human connection. The solution is spending more time talking openly with children rather than simply reducing screen time.

cards.title: Why Halloween candy rules backfire with kids
cards.body: Ditching restrictive food rules helps children build a healthy, guilt-free relationship with food and treats. Breaking free from diet culture during Halloween allows kids to develop better long-term eating habits.

cards.title: Frustrated with parenting advice? Try a different approach
cards.body: Despite abundant parenting guidance, children don't seem to be doing better overall. A fresh perspective and stepping back from conventional wisdom may be more effective.

cards.title: Teaching children to spot AI-generated content
cards.body: Research with 8- and 9-year-olds reveals practical strategies parents can use to teach kids critical thinking about online media. Teaching children to question AI-generated videos helps them navigate digital content safely.

cards.title: How early helplessness shapes human development
cards.body: Unlike a baby giraffe that walks within an hour, human newborns are helpless for years. This extended dependency period is actually key to developing the advanced cognitive abilities that make humans unique.

cards.title: Curiosity over judgment for adult children relationships
cards.body: Parents who mistake their adult children's independence for rejection risk creating estrangement. Replacing judgment with genuine curiosity helps maintain meaningful connections with grown kids.

cards.title: Why resilience requires support, not just willpower
cards.body: Resilience isn't simply about powering through challenges alone—it requires safe spaces and supportive people. Finding community during difficult times is essential for building true resilience.
